opening.argument: The video is framed as practical career guidance, beginning with “9 Online jobs for students to earn without investment” and introducing work that makes use of viewers’ strengths. It presents several ordinary online work options, including teaching, digital and social media marketing, content development, web or mobile app development, and freelancing through established websites such as Upwork and Fiverr. Affiliate links and Meesho reselling are described as commerce or commission-based mechanisms rather than as a single payment or investment scheme, and the speaker acknowledges that some earnings may require sustained effort. The request to subscribe and activate notifications is ordinary channel engagement. Nothing described establishes deception or shows that viewers must make a required payment to participate.
